settings.title: Carriage
settings.body:
UK shipping is free on orders over £20, and free Royal Mail Tracked 24 over £70. Below £20 it is charged at checkout before you pay.

Once dispatched, UK orders arrive in 1–2 working days. International orders take 7–14 working days. Tracking is emailed the moment your parcel leaves us.

International customers are responsible for any customs duties or import taxes. These are set by your country, not by us, and we cannot predict or refund them.

settings.title: Dispatch
settings.body:
Orders placed before 18:00 are dispatched the same day where possible, Monday to Saturday. Orders placed after 18:00, or on a Sunday, go out on the next dispatch day.

After a drop, allow up to two working days — we would rather pack every order properly than promise a cutoff we cannot hold.

settings.title: Returns
settings.body:
You have 14 days from delivery to tell us you want to return something, and 14 days from then to post it back.

Items must be unworn, unwashed, and have their tags attached. Return postage is paid by you unless the item was faulty or we sent the wrong thing.

Put your order number in the parcel. Without it we cannot match the return to you, and it will sit unrefunded.

Returns go to: Oairo UK Office, Bourne End Business Park, Bourne End, Buckinghamshire, SL8 5AS, United Kingdom.

settings.title: Size swaps
settings.body:
UK size swaps are free: we do not charge a fee for the exchange, and we cover the postage sending the new size out to you. You cover the postage sending the original back.

Swaps depend on the size being in stock. If it is not, we refund you instead.

settings.title: Faults and wrong items
settings.body:
If we sent the wrong item, or it arrived faulty or damaged, that is on us. Message us with your order number and a photo and we will refund or replace it in full, postage included.

For transit damage, tell us within 48 hours of delivery so we can raise it with the courier while the claim is still open.

settings.title: Refunds
settings.body:
Approved refunds go back to your original payment method within 5–7 days of us receiving the item.

Original shipping charges are not refunded unless the item was faulty or wrongly sent. Items marked final sale are labelled as such on the product page and cannot be returned.

None of this affects your statutory rights.

settings.title: Lost parcels
settings.body:
If tracking says delivered and nothing has arrived, check with your neighbours and your safe place first, then tell us within 14 days of the expected delivery date.

We will open an investigation with the courier. Royal Mail allow up to 10 working days to complete one. We cannot refund or replace before that investigation closes.

settings.title: Orders we cancel
settings.body:
We can cancel and refund any order in full: if a piece oversells, if the delivery address is wrong or undeliverable, or if we believe automated checkout software was used.

Drops are for people, not scripts.

settings.title: Contact
settings.body: Email crooksldn@gmail.com or DM @crooksldn with your order number. We reply within 1–2 working days.
